owner_direction: Biological-family separation with exact chemical purge; report scaffold/near-analogue overlap without chemical OOD claim
rank_rule: Frozen family_rank then assay_rank; first eligible, never outcome-based replacement
canonicalization: RDKit 2026.09.1 canonical isomeric SMILES; retain salts, charges, tautomers and isotopes; no fragment/tautomer standardization
duplicate_rule: Remove every row belonging to a repeated canonical structure within an assay, without comparing labels
prior_exposure_purge: All canonical structures in all three full prior NCATS .smiles files and the HIV1200 resource
cross_role_purge: Remove shared canonical structures from EVERY role, using all fixed reserved candidate assay pools before family/assay selection
within_role_overlap: Retain and report; assays/seeds never count as independent families
family_analysis_weighting: Equal weight per family; average assays and seeds within family
scaffold_audit: Nonempty canonical Murcko scaffolds; report acyclic empty-scaffold counts separately
failure_handling: Keep all attempts and sanitized reasons; abort on integrity/role/access/global-resource failure; no unranked additional reserve after quota failure
label_access: Trusted row parse with only positive structure/identity projection; no semantic outcome use or prevalence export; final outcome bytes remain only in original ignored archive
